title: The Signal of Halcyon Drift
author: Cyrus Sterling
blurb: Ansel Almeida, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
